ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels localized to the outer lobes and 55% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central proximal region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous blobs are situated at the distal tips of both lobes. The left lobe displays more irregular interior mottling and high-intensity clusters, whereas the right lobe shows a more distinct, solid high-intensity tip. The central region is dominated by a solid low-intensity black pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a deep bounding-box profile and an estimated interior angle of 65-70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency pixel variations; amplitude of peaks is most pronounced at the distal lobe tips, becoming smoother as the contour approaches the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the outer edges, tapering to acute upward-oriented terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular high-contrast clusters (white rings on black background) on the right lobe; several dark circular focal spots on the high-intensity white tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned linear pixel disruptions, including horizontal and diagonal rake marks, visible across the transition zones between high and low intensity pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring patterns consisting of multiple linear rake marks and circular rosette-type lesions consistent with historical parasitic or barnacle colonization.
